The [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] operated a '''treasury space station''' located halfway between the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic disk]] and one of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]]&ndash;the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]]. Though primarily used as a storehouse and a communications relay, the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was modified by the Banking Clan on the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to function as a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] capable of manufacturing [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
Located at a point halfway between the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic disk]]<ref name="ICC" /> and the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]] dwarf satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="Rishi" /> the treasury [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was owned and utilized by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="ICC" /> Like other Banking Clan installations, it contained meeting spaces and hidden vaults, and boasted communication equipment<ref name="EGW" /> used by the Banking Clan to discretely transmit account information and other data without accessing the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="ICC" /> On the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the station, like other Banking Clan facilities, was refurbished to serve as a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] capable of producing [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]].<ref name="EGW" />

==History==
The treasury station was one<ref name="ICC" /> of many facilities located outside the galactic disk that was operated by the InterGalactic Banking Clan in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the Clone Wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After joining the Confederacy prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the war, the Banking Clan modified its [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] stations to function as shipyards, and these installations became homes to [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction crews that produced ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] for the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. The amount of ''Munificent''-class frigates constructed for the Separatist war effort at these refitted stations, when combined with the output of shipyards found on Banking Clan [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], numbered in the tens of thousands.<ref name="EGW" /> The frigate ''[[Tide of Progress XII/Legends|Tide of Progress XII]]'', which participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] near the end of the Clone Wars, hailed from the remote treasury station.<ref name="ICC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I like the idea of Banking Clan space stations outside of the galactic disk, with secret vaults and shipyards. I bet the locations of some of them were lost after the Clone Wars, and they're still out there, waiting for someone to find them and stumble upon a wealth of credits and war materiel. That would make for a cool story, right?|Jason Fry, on the Banking Clan space station|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}</ref>}}
The Banking Clan treasury space station was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]] that provided background information on many vehicles and vessels that appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The station was referenced in a caption identifying the ''Munificent''-class frigate ''Tide of Progress XII''.<ref name="ICC" /> In [[2012]], the station was briefly alluded to in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which revealed the existence of other extragalactic Banking Clan installations that were converted for wartime purposes.<ref name="EGW" /> In the [http://jasonfry.tumblr.com/post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6 endnotes] for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', author [[Jason Fry]] proposed that some of the Banking Clan's extragalactic facilities may have been forgotten following the end of the Clone Wars, their vaults still filled with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and other supplies.<ref name="Endnotes" />
